source: PrivateFit transcript export, Noise Icon Plus (MOYOUNG-V2, MOY-BEU3-2.3.5) on a Galaxy S23, 2026-10-13 21:52 IST (UTC+5:30), NoiseFit still installed
notes: The phone's OS had negotiated MTU 247 but ble-plx reported 23, so the app framed in the short form; the watch frames its own messages in the long form (FE EA 20 ...).
The two 0x6D frames arrived right after a 40 s heart-rate stream on 0x2A37: a measurement started on the watch reports FF while measuring, then the result (0x4A = 74 bpm).
No reply followed the clock frame (command 49) or the find-watch frame (command 97).

frames.note: command 49 sync time, sent at 16:23:01 UTC = 21:53:01 IST; payload = local wall-clock as GMT+8 epoch, zone byte 8
command 109 from the watch: result 74 bpm
command 49 again from the settings screen, 135 s later
